en: The postcard features sepia-toned imagery of a large, formal building complex with German architectural features, including dormer windows and stone foundations. The entrance is marked by an ornate gate with the inscription 'König-Friedrich-August-Kaserne.' There are multiple buildings and a gatehouse, along with people and what appears to be a military or official post setting. Signs of early automobiles or horse-drawn transport might suggest an early 20th-century timeframe. At the top, the text 'Leisnig i. Sa.' and 'König-Friedrich-August-Kaserne. Haupteingang.' are visible.
